title: [LOGGED IN] Logout with the "Player12580628" button
reason: Logout via Player12580628 button works; Login shown, balances gone, stays logged out after reload, Reward chain shows 'Login to claim'

steps.text: Start a new browser session with no saved cookies. Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/?user-id=12580628 in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Store page loaded at https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ (user-id removed from URL); cookie banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss". If any other popup is shown after login, close it. Do not click the "Player12580628" button: it logs out.
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss on the cookie banner; no Login successful popup shown

steps.text: Does the header show a green "Player12580628" button and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Header: Home, Store, Reward chain, Loyalty shop, teal 200, gold 0, green 'Player12580628' button; no Login button

steps.text: Click the green "Player12580628" button in the header.
steps.saw: Clicked Player12580628; header changed immediately with no confirmation

steps.text: Is a green "Login" button shown in the header?
steps.saw: Green 'Login' button (gradient rgb(12,150,87) -> rgb(118,211,71)) at top right

steps.text: Are the two balances gone from the header?
steps.saw: Header text is only Home, Store, Reward chain, Loyalty shop, Login; teal 200 and gold 0 balances gone

steps.text: Reload the page and wait until it has finished loading.
steps.saw: Page reloaded (navigation type 'reload'), readyState complete, URL https://site.ludus-game.com/store/

steps.text: Is the green "Login" button still shown (the user stays logged out)?
steps.saw: After reload header still shows green 'Login', no balances, no player button

steps.text: Click "Reward chain" in the header. Is the "Login to claim" button shown in the Rewards Market?
steps.saw: Scrolled to Rewards Market (0/500 points, Step 1 of 10); green 'Login to claim' button shown below the rewards
